interactions.label: Cantonese opera & familiar songs · 粵劇
interactions.description: A guest performer in full opera costume sings Cantonese opera excerpts; water-sleeve gestures and familiar songs invite requests from the room. Watch, clap or join in from a chair, wheelchair or standing position.

interactions.label: Baduanjin qigong · the Eight Brocades · 八段錦
interactions.description: Eight slow, named movements such as 'holding up the heavens', led by a qigong teacher in practice silks. Every movement has a seated version; rest whenever needed.

interactions.label: Everyday device skills
interactions.description: Practice WeChat and video calls with family, photos and larger text using step-by-step visual prompts. One-to-one help, a supported tablet and repeatable small steps.

interactions.label: Everyday movement
interactions.description: A staff-led group with familiar music and easy-to-follow demonstrations. Standing, chair-based or wheelchair upper-body movement; rest whenever needed.

interactions.label: Fan dance · 扇子舞
interactions.description: Silk folding fans open, turn and flutter to Chinese folk music, led by a dance teacher in a qipao. Standing steps or seated fan and arm movements.

interactions.label: Tai chi together · 太極拳
interactions.description: Yang-style 'cloud hands' and slow weight shifts, led by a teacher in white practice silks. A seated version mirrors the upper-body sequence; a care aide stays nearby.

interactions.label: Language circle & lantern riddles · 猜燈謎
interactions.description: Riddles hung on red lanterns and familiar sayings in Cantonese, Mandarin and English; a bilingual host reads each one aloud. Listen, point to a picture or speak at your own pace.

interactions.label: Silk ribbon dance · 彩帶舞
interactions.description: Long silk ribbons trace circles and waves to folk melodies. Short ribbons and seated arm patterns are available.

interactions.label: Erhu & sing-along · 二胡
interactions.description: A two-string erhu leads favorite folk songs; participants keep time with shakers and a hand drum. Lightweight shakers and a supported hand drum; listening is welcome.

interactions.label: TCM & seasonal wellness talk · 中醫養生
interactions.description: A TCM practitioner explains seasonal foods, herbal teas and acupressure points with a wall chart; the host interprets questions. Seated listening, visual prompts and time for questions; a quiet table option stays available.

interactions.label: Calligraphy & brushwork · 書法
interactions.description: Brush, ink stone and rice paper: practising personally meaningful characters with a calligraphy teacher. Thick-handled brushes, supported paper and hand-over-hand help when requested.

interactions.label: Paper-cutting · 剪紙
interactions.description: Folding and cutting red paper into window flowers and the character 福, good fortune. Pre-drawn patterns, spring-loaded scissors, or tearing instead of cutting.

interactions.label: Ink painting · 國畫
interactions.description: Bamboo, plum blossom and orchid in black ink, one brushstroke at a time. Large brushes and pre-printed outlines.

interactions.label: Lantern making · 紮燈籠
interactions.description: Folding red paper lanterns for the next festival; finished lanterns hang over the activity floor. Pre-cut pieces and glue sticks; work in pairs.

interactions.label: Spring couplets · 春聯
interactions.description: Writing paired good-wish verses on red paper, as families do for Lunar New Year. Thick-handled brushes, supported paper and hand-over-hand help when requested.

interactions.label: Morning tea & Chinese newspapers · 早茶·讀報
interactions.description: Jasmine and oolong tea with Chinese-language newspapers; the tea host refills cups and starts conversations about the day's news. Large-print papers; reading aloud is welcome.

interactions.label: Gongfu tea · 功夫茶
interactions.description: Small-pot gongfu tea poured in rounds, with time to talk about family, food and festivals. Light cups with handles; caffeine-free chrysanthemum tea on request.
